platforms.name: besu-qbft-reference-target
platforms.notes: Target template for the permissioned Besu/QBFT reference baseline described in D4.3. The public repository does not include its validator topology or credentials and contains no executed result for this target. Configure through S4C_BESU_RPC, S4C_BESU_CONTRACT and S4C_BESU_FROM. Signing is delegated to the node or to an external signer; no key is read by the harness.

platforms.name: ebsi-pilot
platforms.notes: Requires onboarding to the EBSI pilot environment and a registered decentralised identifier. Write access is granted per organisation, so this entry cannot be exercised without that grant.

platforms.name: algorand-testnet
platforms.notes: Anchoring through a note field or an application call. Requires a funded account and a reachable algod endpoint.

platforms.name: iota-testnet
platforms.notes: Requires a reachable node and, depending on the network configuration, an account able to pay storage costs.

platforms.name: ethereum-sepolia
platforms.notes: Confirmation is probabilistic, so the adapter decides at what depth it reports confirmed. Record that depth: a time to confirmation measured at depth 1 is not comparable with one measured at depth 12.
